integrity: The complete normalized 21-bit sign space is checked by two independent deterministic integer programs included here. The original hafnian identity and standard Fourier inversion are separated from the new exact finite histogram.
scientific_limitations: Exact census only for eight labeled vertices and independent signs on the 28 edges; no higher-order theorem and no exhaustive historical-priority claim. Independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
title: Exact Walsh spectrum and sharp endpoint norm of the eight-vertex perfect-matching orbit
